description: Short face outside the right-hand pier. A separate green sign on this wall belongs to the adjacent opening. It supplies a visual control for triangulation; its address is outside this reconstruction.
reference: Same-date December 2015 street photographs. The short wall and its tile bond are also visible in February 2020.
uncertainty: The two December 2015 stations agree on the sign plane to less than one pixel. The third, more oblique view misses the manually read corner by about 16 px. The wall return and hidden foundations are approximate.
